#!/bin/bash

# Weekly Docker Cleanup Script
# This script removes unused Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks

LOG_FILE="/tmp/docker_cleanup.log"

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "$(date): $1" >> $LOG_FILE
}

log_message "Starting weekly Docker cleanup"

# Remove stopped containers
log_message "Removing stopped containers"
docker container prune -f >> $LOG_FILE 2>&1

# Remove unused images
log_message "Removing unused images"
docker image prune -f >> $LOG_FILE 2>&1

# Remove unused volumes
log_message "Removing unused volumes"
docker volume prune -f >> $LOG_FILE 2>&1

# Remove unused networks
log_message "Removing unused networks"
docker network prune -f >> $LOG_FILE 2>&1
